Postgraduate Master's in Computer Science for Sub-Saharan Africa

Provider: DAAD

Target group: Graduates applying for a Master's degree in Computer Science

Field of study: Computer Science and Data Science

Who can apply? Excellent graduates from Sub-Saharan African countries including Benin

What is funded? Full tuition fees and a monthly living allowance for the whole Master's programme

Country of study: Germany

Eligibility criteria: International applicants may apply from abroad through the DAAD portal

Application deadline: 15 October 2030
